g.text: The 1 114 firms whose core number reaches 25: one ring per level, deepest at the centre. Radius is therefore a measured quantity rather than the output of a placement algorithm. Angle follows community, so a

community occupies a sector of every ring it reaches. The innermost ring (k = 71, 72 firms) is the complete graph figure 26 takes apart: it is at the centre because one director puts it there. Rings are spaced one per
occupied level rather than in proportion to k, so the 24 empty levels between 46 and 71 show here as one gap among many; figure 19 shows them as they are.
